name: pickup_type_get_by_index
description: PickupType::GetByIndex returns an in-range entry from the global 40-entry pickup type table and null for negative or out-of-range indexes.
known_limits: The shared pickup leaf-helper smoke also covers adjacent pickup leaf functions. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Pickup runtime pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e1c0 validates the signed lower-bound check, upper-bound check against 40, indexed access to g_PickupTypes, and null return for invalid indexes.
The native pickup leaf-helper smoke verifies indexes 0 and 39 return table entries while -1 and 40 return null.
